goal: load_policy parses the [sandbox.*] tables into a frozen SandboxPolicy on WorkPolicy, resolving the fast preset, rejecting unknown presets and malformed values, and ignoring unknown keys.

relevant: .flywheel/specs/00037-sandbox-config-foundation.md -- the acceptance criteria SC-2/3/4/7 this task satisfies, and the fast baseline table
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_policy.py -- WorkPolicy and load_policy; add SandboxPolicy + sub-dataclasses + [sandbox.*] parsing here
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_sandbox_policy.py -- the held-out oracle for this task; make it green, do not edit it
references: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_policy.py -- mirror the existing _optional_* strict-validate / forward-compat validator pattern (keyed PolicyError messages, unknown keys ignored)
constraints: The fast preset values must equal today verbatim (00037 baseline table), using omit-on-unset sentinels (e.g. capabilities.setting_sources defaults to None) so downstream option construction can stay byte-identical.

Add exactly one nested frozen field WorkPolicy.sandbox: SandboxPolicy holding frozen sub-dataclasses (capabilities, network, env, limits, retention, exec); leave the existing flat sandbox_setup field and its callers untouched.
No claude_agent_sdk import anywhere in this change; SandboxPolicy holds only primitives.

Only the fast preset is defined; any other preset name fails fast with a PolicyError naming the preset. Present-but-malformed values fail fast with a {path}: sandbox.<key> message; unknown keys under any [sandbox.*] table are ignored.
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do not wire anything to ClaudeAgentOptions or the agent invocation -- that is the sandbox-policy-live-wire task.
Do not define the balanced or hardened presets.
Do not enforce network, env, limits, retention, or exec -- this task only parses them onto the policy (they are inert until later increments).
Do not modify files under tests/; do not weaken or delete assertions in the held-out oracle.
edge_cases: An absent [sandbox] section (or [sandbox] setup only) resolves to the fast preset.
A per-key override (e.g. [sandbox.limits] max_turns) changes only that key; untouched keys and tables keep their fast values.
[sandbox.network] policy = "deny" parses and is carried on the policy but enforces nothing (advisory until increment G).
List-replace vs append cannot be discriminated while every preset list is empty; that semantics is exercised in a later increment, not here.
